description:
Performance-focused titanium gravel. Exceptional value.
Discover the Enigma Edge MK.II, a titanium gravel bike designed for riders who enjoy pushing the pace, exploring challenging terrain and making the most of every gravel ride. Combining responsive handling, all-day comfort and the unmistakable ride quality of titanium, the Edge is equally at home on fast gravel routes, rough tracks and mixed-surface adventures.
Built around a beautifully finished 3Al/2.5V titanium frame and equipped with Shimano GRX 11-speed mechanical 1x shifting, DT Swiss wheels and a C-Six carbon fork, the Edge delivers a superb balance of performance, control and versatility.
SAVE 30% – LIMITED REMAINING STOCK
With the Edge now succeeded by the latest-generation Enigma Eremos, we're offering the final remaining Edge MK.II builds at 30% below their original retail price. Every bike is brand new and unused, complete with a full Enigma warranty.

Available Sizes
Available in 50cm, 52cm and 60cm, while remaining stock lasts.
Once they're gone, they're gone.
A rare opportunity to own an Enigma titanium gravel bike equipped with Shimano GRX mechanical 1x shifting at an exceptional price. II gravel bike.
